questions.question:
[경로: Mevalonate(MVA) 경로 — 세포질]
다음 경로에서 ★로 표시한 물질의 이름은?

[[rxn:CC(=O)SC>>CC(=O)CC(=O)SC|acetyl-CoA, Claisen]]
(★ → acetoacetyl-CoA)

[[rxn:CC(=O)CC(=O)SC>>OC(=O)CC(C)(O)CC(=O)SC|acetyl-CoA, aldol]]
(acetoacetyl-CoA → HMG-CoA)
questions.explanation:
정답: acetyl-CoA
전체 경로:
acetyl-CoA →(acetyl-CoA, Claisen)→ acetoacetyl-CoA
acetoacetyl-CoA →(acetyl-CoA, aldol)→ HMG-CoA
HMG-CoA →(HMG-CoA reductase, NADPH)→ mevaldic acid
mevaldic acid →(NADPH)→ mevalonic acid
mevalonic acid →(2 × ATP)→ mevalonic acid 5-diphosphate
mevalonic acid 5-diphosphate →(ATP, −CO₂)→ IPP
IPP →(isomerase)→ DMAPP
참고: CoA는 –SCH₃로 줄여 그렸다.
그림:
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/iso-p11.png|PPT iso-p11]]
[[img:pharmacognosy/local/iso-p14.png|PPT iso-p14]]
